title: Created an indie cyberpunk adventure game with a full featured, FREE 3-hour story campaign in Unity with AI tools. (Midjourney, Sora, RunwayML, Act-One, Elevenlabs, ImmersityAI, Suno, Blockade, Magnific)
author: mikeeeT

comments.author: mikeeeT
comments.body:
Hey all! we just released my indie cyberpunk adventure game in Steam on 4/20. If you're into story-rich adventures, intricate mysteries, or simply want to see an adorable Shiba Inu, give our game a try!

It's 100% free to play.

We're genuinely curious to hear what you all think. Hope you liked our trailer!

Cheers!

comments.author: Alone-Amphibian2434
comments.body: Is the gameplay just a montage of screenshots

replies.author: mikeeeT
replies.body: The gameplay is a mix of point and click, screenlife, and a mechanic we experimented on where you zoom into buildings to hack into (it's inspired by a lot of other games, we made use of AI upscaling to achieve this.

comments.author: Itchy_Mycologist_513
comments.body:
I’m curious, how many people worked on this game? How long did it take to develop it? Reading your process blog, it looks like a pretty in depth development process.
Great job btw! I’m downloading it.

replies.author: mikeeeT
replies.body:
Thank you! We're a small team of 4(ish). It took us about a year (I know!). the tools changed so much we had to remake a lot of the art.
we used a lot of the techniques we learned from our previous game, which was made way before we had character consistency.

comments.author: Prpl_Moth
comments.body:
Are you trying to appear more frequently in Steam searches by making each word in your game's name start with an A?

replies.author: mikeeeT
replies.body: No, but now that you mention it... The idea of Aliya as our main character is that she's actually the same character in both games but on a different timeline/universe.

replies.author: Prpl_Moth
